label: В
description: Location versus motion into a place. This pack teaches the contrast between being in something and going into it.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Static location. 'В доме' uses the prepositional case to mark where I am right now. There is no movement here, only a fixed position inside the house.
Strategic focus: Motion into a place. 'Иду' is motion on foot, and 'в дом' takes the accusative to mark direction. This contrasts directly with the static 'в доме'.
Strategic focus: Object location. 'В комнате' uses the prepositional case to place the book inside a room. The verb 'лежит' confirms a fixed position, not motion.
Strategic focus: Putting something into something. 'В сумку' takes the accusative to show destination into an object. The action verb 'кладу' drives the movement of placement.
Strategic focus: Settled location. 'В городе' uses the prepositional case to mark a place of residence. There is no motion, just a stable everyday location.
Strategic focus: Static plural location. 'В школе' uses the prepositional case to state where we currently are. The subject 'мы' stays simple with no movement involved.
Strategic focus: Motion toward a place. 'Идём' shows plural movement, and 'в школу' takes the accusative for direction toward school. This cleanly contrasts with 'в школе'.
Strategic focus: Current position. 'В магазине' uses the prepositional case to mark where he is right now. This is everyday static location without any movement.
Strategic focus: Movement into a place. 'Идёт' is motion on foot, and 'в магазин' takes the accusative for destination. The pair 'в магазине' versus 'в магазин' is a core contrast.
Strategic focus: Static location with a special form. 'В саду' is the locative form in the prepositional case, marking where she is. There is no motion, just position.
Strategic focus: Motion into the garden. 'Идёт' shows movement, and 'в сад' takes the accusative to mark the destination. This trains the difference from static 'в саду'.
Strategic focus: Container location. 'В стакане' uses the prepositional case to place the water inside the glass. The phrase is static, showing position in a small container.
Strategic focus: Motion into a container. 'Наливаю' is a direct action verb, and 'в стакан' takes the accusative to mark the destination of the liquid.
Strategic focus: Residence in a place. 'Живут' is plural and present, and 'в центре' uses the prepositional case for a static location. It describes where people are based.
Strategic focus: Direction toward a place. 'Идут' shows plural motion, and 'в центр' takes the accusative to mark the destination. This is the movement version of 'в центре'.
Strategic focus: Direction of gaze. 'Смотрит' directs attention, and 'в окно' takes the accusative to mark direction. This shows that 'в' can express direction, not just place.
Strategic focus: Looking into a device. 'Смотрит' directs the gaze, and 'в телефон' takes the accusative to mark direction. This is a modern, current everyday phrase.
Strategic focus: Speaking in a place. 'В классе' uses the prepositional case for a static location where the talking happens. The verb 'говорим' is first-person plural.
Strategic focus: Motion into the classroom. 'Идём' is plural motion, and 'в класс' takes the accusative to mark direction. This is the clean contrast to static 'в классе'.
Strategic focus: Return into a place. 'Вернуться' is a reflexive motion verb, and 'в дом' takes the accusative to mark the destination of the return.
